label: prepare-auditable-publish-manifest
command: import pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib; root=pathlib.Path("."); p=root/"research/base-miku-a15/inspection.json"; new=json.loads(p.read_text()); old=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:research/base-miku-a15/inspection.json"],text=True)); old["additional_inspections"]=[new]; p.write_text(json.dumps(old,indent=2)+"\n"); large=["research/candidates/mi8937-os4/inode-metadata.json","research/wayne-os4-system-metadata.json"]; report={n:{"size":(root/n).stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"reproducible_with":"tools/erofs_metadata.py"} for n in large}; (root/"research/metadata-inventory-hashes.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n"); files=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard"],text=True).splitlines()+subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines()); files={n for n in files if not n.startswith("downloads/") and not n.endswith(".md")}; records=[{"path":n,"size":(root/n).stat().st_size,"mode":"100755" if (root/n).stat().st_mode&0o111 else "100644"} for n in sorted(files) if (root/n).is_file()]; pathlib.Path("/tmp/wayne-publish-files.json").write_text(json.dumps(records)); print(json.dumps({"files":len(records),"bytes":sum(r["size"] for r in records),"large":[r for r in records if r["size"]>200000]}))
